title: Weapon Component
description: Base weapon component defining shared weapon properties.
content:
Weapon Component

Base weapon component defining shared weapon properties such as damage, knockback, and type.

Component Weapon

Schema

JSON
"weaponComponent": {
  "damage": 0,
  "knockback": 0.0,
  "type": "..."
}

Description

The WeaponComponent is the base weapon component that defines shared weapon properties. It provides the foundation for all weapon types, including common attributes such as damage output, knockback force, and weapon classification. Specialized weapon components like ShooterComponent and MeleeComponent extend this base to add type-specific behavior.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
damageintBase damage dealt by the weapon per hit.
knockbackfloatForce applied to the target on hit, pushing them away.
typestringThe weapon classification type (e.g., "melee", "ranged", "explosive").

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "weaponComponent": {
      "damage": 25,
      "knockback": 3.5,
      "type": "ranged"
    }
  }
}
